'''Hus'yoyu''' was one of the [[Gods of Age]], a group of seventeen gods that were worshipped by the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Hus'yoyu was prayed to by Fia that were under the age of six.<ref name="CCW" />
